senses.zh_definition: Smitty：英语人名或昵称，可作为 Smith 的昵称；不是已核实的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Smitty: an English personal name or nickname associated with Smith; not a verified Malay common-word entry.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang boleh digunakan sebagai nama atau nama panggilan bagi Smith; bukan kata umum bahasa Melayu yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处按英语专名作条件性解释，不能据无上下文的输入确定具体人物。pos 为 noun，实际类别是 kata nama khas；status 保留 unverified，避免冒称获得马来语官方词典认证。以下组合为专名用法示例，并非已证实的高频马来语搭配。[Collins：Smitty](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/smitty)

dual_scenarios.en: The company representative who introduced himself as Smitty will attend the meeting.

etymology.historical_story: English dictionaries identify Smitty as a personal name related to Smith, and nickname research discusses the Smith-to-Smitty pairing. Such a name can appear unchanged inside a Malay sentence without becoming a Malay common word. The packet provides no contextual evidence identifying a particular bearer, so the name interpretation remains provisional for this item. [Sources: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/smitty), [Nicknames and the Lexicon](https://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/document?doi=b41bac258e583055dd85495714c999482317b582&repid=rep1&type=pdf)
